summary: Iteration 114 — All three follow-up features verified end-to-end on backend + web. Backend: 9/9 pytest PASS (iter114.xml). (1) HEAL-ALL THUMBNAILS: POST /api/admin/channels/thumbnails/heal-all is anon→403, admin returns {ok:true, missing:int, started:bool}, idempotent when fleet is healthy (missing=0, started=False), and truly regenerates durably to Tigris when files vanish. Verified by deleting BOTH the local disk file /app/backend/static/channel_thumbnails/vip_lounge.webp AND the Tigris key static/channel_thumbnails/vip_lounge.webp via services.object_storage.get_storage().delete(): _thumb_missing('vip_lounge') flipped to True, heal-all returned missing>=1 & started=True, and within 120s _thumb_missing became False again AND storage.exists() confirmed the durable Tigris copy was regenerated (Gemini Nano Banana call ~40s). (2) FRESH ART VARIATION: POST /api/imported-stations/{sid}/artwork/generate with {"variation": true} returns a prompt containing 'alternate take <nonce>'. Body {} (no variation) returns a prompt WITHOUT 'alternate take'. Two successive variation calls on non-flagship imp_780122061aa111e9a8 produced DIFFERENT final image URLs (polled /artwork/status until complete for each) — NOT the same cached image. Previous cover archived to artwork_history (GET /artwork/history returns >=1 entry). (3) REGRESSION ensure-flagship-art: two successive calls, q2<=q1, self-heal cache-hit path still intact. Frontend web: On /admin/flagship-stations the Fleet health row shows exactly FOUR buttons in this order: Run health check, Re-seed manifest, Heal flagship art (data-testid admin-flagship-heal-art), Heal channel thumbnails (data-testid admin-flagship-heal-thumbnails, ImagePlus icon, cyan tint). Clicking Heal channel thumbnails fires POST /api/admin/channels/thumbnails/heal-all and shows toast 'All channel thumbnails are healthy' (admin-flagship-toast). Heal flagship art still shows 'All flagship artwork is healthy'. All 11 per-row Sparkles buttons present; clicking admin-flagship-big-1062-uae-gen-art POSTs {variation:true} and toasts 'Generating fresh art for Big 106.2 UAE…'. On /radio/news the news-radio-ticker renders ABOVE the player with a cyan 'LIVE NEWS' pill (Radio icon) and horizontally-scrolling headlines using className news-ticker-track (keyframes news-ticker-scroll in index.css:148). Verified live text: 'LIVE NEWS ● Nepal-Tibet floods: China suspends rescue efforts…● Partial lunar eclipse Aug. 27-28…' etc. Ticker correctly hidden when entries list is empty (early-return null). No console errors of significance (only unrelated 401s for background wallet/notif endpoints before admin cookie is set).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/admin_phase19.py:65 heal-all-thumbnails counts 'missing' via _thumb_missing() (a synchronous disk stat + Tigris HEAD per channel) inside the request path — fine at 14 channels but O(N) HEADs per admin click. If the fleet grows, cache the missing count from the last background sweep or move the probe into the background task and return an accepted-async 202.

backend/services/channel_thumbnails.py:277 heal_all_thumbnails() is fire-and-forget from the endpoint (asyncio.create_task) with no per-slug status write. If Gemini fails for 3/14 slugs, the admin sees 'started:true' and no way to know the fleet still has 3 gaps except by clicking again. Consider persisting a heal_run doc with per-slug outcomes so /admin can show a partial-failure banner.

backend/routes/imported_station_artwork.py:281 Variation nonce is generated with secrets.token_hex(3) — 24 bits = ~16M combos. Practically unique for owner regenerations, but with the same prompt suffix ('alternate take {nonce}.') the model's cache in OpenAI could still occasionally deduplicate on the leading prompt. If observed, bump to token_hex(8) or add a rotating adjective (‘moodier’, ‘brighter’, …).

backend/routes/imported_station_artwork.py:281 variation is only honored on /artwork/generate, not on /ensure-flagship-art. The heal-flagship-art self-heal correctly reuses cache (that's the point) but if an operator wants to force fresh art on every flagship, they must click each row's Sparkles button. A ‘Regenerate all flagship art (fresh)’ admin action could bulk this later.

frontend/src/NewsRadio.jsx:24 Ticker duration heuristic dur=max(18, totalChars*0.16) doesn't account for viewport width — a very short queue (e.g. 1 headline of 20 chars) yields dur=18s which may still feel too slow. Consider clamping to a min of 12s or scaling by container width.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4 buttons + toasts + ticker + variation flow verified live)

Verified via services.channel_thumbnails._thumb_missing('vip_lounge') flipping True→False and storage.exists('static/channel_thumbnails/vip_lounge.webp')==True. (b) imp_780122061aa111e9a8 (MANGORADIO) had two fresh variations generated back-to-back, producing two different /api/static/station_artwork/*.webp URLs; the prior art was archived to artwork_history (retrievable via GET /artwork/history). (c) imp_fun_big_1062_uae had one flagship variation generated ('alternate take' nonce confirmed in returned prompt) then polled to complete; flg-*.webp key present in Tigris.
